'''Coolth''' was a series of chemicals used in [[coolth suit]]s and [[Coolth backpack/Legends|coolth backpacks]], in addition to cooling buildings in [[Desert/Legends|desert]] environs.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
